summary.text: Angelo Mancuso is an independent candidate for the Alabama House of Representatives, District 7, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Ernie Yarbrough and independent Trent Ford.
His professional experience includes working as a dermatologic surgeon.

paragraphs.text: Angelo Mancuso was the Democratic nominee for Alabama State Senate District 4 in 2014, when Republican incumbent Paul Bussman defeated him 73.5 percent to 26.4 percent.

According to Ballotpedia, his 2014 campaign website listed a plan that included refusing a legislative salary, supporting a temporary Medicaid expansion program, supporting term limits for state-elected officials, and holding frequent town hall meetings.
